name: PC-3 re-test against the same-channel surrogate reference (decides the PC-3 gate; EXP-001 and EXP-005 stay FAIL)
status_of_criteria: third surrogate criterion, chosen after EXP-001 and EXP-005 failed and after the mechanism diagnostics (cebafe7); disclosed; fresh seeds; frozen and pushed before the EXP-006 run

synthetic_design.background: independent per channel, Gaussian with 1/f power spectrum (exponent 1), no inter-channel coupling
synthetic_design.reference: CAR over the 19 channels, as in the real pipeline
synthetic_design.window_starts_s: 6 + 3k (k = 0..n_windows-1); the first and last 4 s of each recording are never used

lag_test.lag_sign_meaning: +1: channel j lags channel i (expected sign of sum Im(z_i conj z_j) > 0); -1: i lags j
lag_test.lag: integer-sample delay nearest to a quarter period at the band centre (theta 6, alpha 10.5, beta 21.5 Hz)
lag_test.burst: band-limited Gaussian noise (same Butterworth order-4 band-pass) times a 1.6-s Hann taper centred in each window; the delayed copy is added to the lagging channel
lag_test.snr_meaning: burst RMS over the taper's non-zero span = snr x the source channel's in-band background RMS

seeds.surrogates: 06 section 4.3 step 8 rule with eeg_id 'SYN6-LAG-<band>' or 'SYN6-NULL-<band>'
seeds.same_channel_reference: 06 section 4.3 step 8 rule with eeg_id 'SYN6-LAG-<band>-REF' (second, independent surrogate of the same channel)

same_channel_reference.definition: per window, realisation r and channel c of a coupled pair: wPLI between the FC_surr IAAFT surrogate of c (seed rule, eeg_id 'SYN6-LAG-<band>') and a second, independent IAAFT surrogate of c (eeg_id 'SYN6-LAG-<band>-REF'); window Hilbert; averaged over realisations and windows
same_channel_reference.meaning: wPLI produced by single-channel properties alone (spectrum and amplitude distribution), with no coupling by construction

surrogate_destruction.lag_direction_at_chance: per coupled edge, the share of windows x realisations whose surrogate sum Im(z_i conj z_j) has the injected sign lies in [0.35, 0.65] (chance 0.5; 150 draws, SE 0.041)
surrogate_destruction.excess_definition: per coupled edge (a, b) and for each of its channels c in {a, b}: mean over windows of k-averaged FC_surr wPLI on (a, b) minus the same-channel reference of c; every value must be <= 0.02

null_coupling_match.offset: per window: mean over 171 edges of real wPLI minus mean of k-averaged surrogate wPLI; 95% t-interval over windows

reported_not_criteria: EXP-001 checks (coupled vs all uncoupled edges)
criteria.pass_rule: PASS only if every criterion holds in every primary band (theta, alpha, beta)
